description: Coordinates end-to-end multi-slice feature delivery across specialized agents from refinement through parallel implementation and optional production and test audits
when_to_use: Invoke to drive a multi-slice or multi-module feature from ticket to verified delivery using refiner, implementer, and (when agent-audit is installed) prod-auditor and test-auditor. Avoid for small single-file or localized tasks where a single agent is faster and cheaper.
